items.title: Malaysia central bank launches DLT platform for tokenized bonds
items.snippet: The platform tracks tokenized securities ownership and transfers, linking to Malaysia’s RENTAS+ system to settle corresponding payments in central bank money.

items.title: Ripple brings Wall Street into 24/7 stock bets, but HSBC warns markets are still thin
items.snippet: Institutions can trade through Ripple Prime and post RLUSD as collateral. Finding enough buyers and sellers for large positions could prove harder.

items.snippet: A private key generation flaw allowed anyone to guess them and forge HTTPS certificates for any website.

items.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
items.snippet: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

items.title: A company that vouches for websites had secret keys so weak that 8 of them were cracked
items.snippet: Eight secret keys at eMudhra, an Indian firm that vouches for websites, were compromised. This is a generic, not crypto-specific, risk.
